name: mdx-message-product-parity-matrix
human_line: Every v1 Message capability, accounted for: shipped, shipped differently on the governed rails, or deferred out loud with the reason.

entries.v1: optimistic insert with temp ids and ACK correlation
entries.note: one outbox path online or offline; the projection's message_id echo replaces ACK correlation

entries.v1: IndexedDB offline queue with idempotency keys
entries.note: IndexedDB, probe-before-resend exactly-once, terminal policy refusals

entries.v1: REST send fallback when the socket was down
entries.note: v2 sends are HTTP-first through the governed write; the socket is delivery-only - stronger than a fallback
named verdicts (caught_up, gap_detected, snapshot_required) and a catching-up state that never fakes live
windowed rendering bounds the DOM (120/room); pixel virtualization deferred until profiling demands it
escape-first renderer shared with Twin; XSS structurally impossible
lanes from recorded actor ids, run folding, and a kernel-enforced workspace posting control with recorded changes
decision cards shipped; build, approval, and incident cards land when those events post to rooms
thread_id reply:<parent receipt id>
append-only +/- events folded at render; receipt-backed by construction; ride the offline outbox
row marks and separate mention badges; role and team mentions deferred until a real roster exists
projection q= with cursor pagination; hits jump and anchor with a flash; semantic search arrives with CTX
/decision /handoff /search /mute; /forge /incident /summarize land when their rails exist
rail with unread and mention badges, create-on-plus, mute
offline banner, queued sends, backoff with jitter, visibility flushes, drain fast-reconnect
typing indicators with honest expiry; a presence roster waits for real identity
hover actions: reply, react, copy receipt, record as decision
consecutive same-actor messages group under one name
the refusal banner, saved flashes, and pending bar cover today's needs; a toast rail is polish for later
needs the real roster and identity work; Talent renders who works here meanwhile
append-only record wants edit-as-amendment receipts - a deliberate kernel contract, queued
metadata-first slice queued; storage policy belongs to the deployment lane

v2_surpluses: every message receipt-backed with provenance one tap away
exactly-once offline sends by design (probe before resend)
named replay verdicts instead of silent gaps
kernel-enforced workspace controls with recorded changes
relay metrics, readiness, graceful drain, and a checked-in 10k-delivery scale proof
agent run folding so chatter never drowns humans
